
{{alias}}( x, b )
    Rounds a single-precision floating-point number to the nearest base-b
    floating-point value.

    Due to floating-point rounding error, rounding may not be exact.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    b: integer
        Integer base (must be greater than or equal to 2).

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Rounded value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 7.9, 2 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 9.1, 10 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0, 2 )
    0

    See Also
    --------
